title: Getting the course code, and the detailed overview

cues.en: In this video, I will tell you how to get all of the code files for this course.
cues.zh: 這段介紹如何取得全課程式檔。

cues.en: So here we are on my GitHub site at the repository called course.
You can get to this webpage by searching for it online, or by looking in the resources section for this video that you're watching right now.
cues.zh: 可上網搜尋，或看目前這段影片的資源區。

cues.en: So there's a button for resources, and then there is a direct link to this website that you are looking at right now.
cues.zh: 有Resources按鈕，裡面有目前網站的直接連結。

cues.en: You can see that this repository has some information down here and so on and up.
Here are several folders one folder for each major part of the course.
cues.zh: 上方幾個資料夾，對應課程各大部分。

cues.en: So then if we just pick this one for example part two, you can see that in this folder there are several other folders.
cues.zh: 例如選part two，裡面又有幾個資料夾。

cues.en: And these correspond to each of the sections in the course in this part of the course.
And then let's say we just pick this one fine tune and we jump into this folder, then you can see there are lots of files in here.
cues.zh: 例如選fine tune，進去看到很多檔案。

cues.en: These are all of the Python notebook files that you will need for this course.
cues.zh: 都是課程需要的Python筆記本。

cues.en: Each file corresponds to one video, and the naming convention of these files is first the part of the course and then the section of the course.
cues.zh: 每檔對應一段影片；命名先課程部分，再章節。

cues.en: So fine tuning and then something about the specific title of that particular video.
cues.zh: 例如fine tuning，再加特定影片標題相關內容。

cues.en: And then if I click on this one for example.
Now you see the notebook file for this video.
So here at the top you also see information about the specific section and the lecture names and so on.
cues.zh: 頂部也有章節、講座名稱等資訊。

cues.en: And now if we scroll down you can see here is all the code that I will go through in this particular video.
cues.zh: 往下看，是那段會講的全部程式。

cues.en: Now if you would have to go through and type all of the code for all the videos, that would just take a million years.
cues.zh: 如果每段全部自己打，要一百萬年。

cues.en: So instead it is much better to To download these files and then use them in Google Colab or some other Python environment.
cues.zh: 所以最好下載，再用Google Colab或其他Python環境。

cues.en: So how do you download all of these files at once?
Well, let's go back to the main repo up here.
And now if you are comfortable working with git, if you're familiar with git you can just clone this repo.
If you have no idea what that means, don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 完全不知道意思，也不用擔心。

cues.en: You do not need to be an expert on GitHub or even have a login.
cues.zh: 不必是GitHub專家，甚至不必登入。

cues.en: All you need to do is look for this button here called code.
Click on that.
Go down here to the bottom and then click on Download ZIP.
There's also a direct link to this file in the resources section of the video.
cues.zh: 影片資源也有這個檔案的直接連結。

cues.en: So you don't even need to go to the GitHub site.
You can just download it directly from the link on Udemy.
Okay.
Now when you click this, it will download every single code file that you will need for this entire course.
cues.zh: 按下後，會下載全課需要的每個程式檔。

cues.en: So now I have downloaded that zip file and now I will unpack it.
And then in here you see all the same files on my computer that I just showed you on my GitHub site.
cues.zh: 電腦裡看到的檔案，和剛才GitHub相同。

cues.en: Now, I actually do not recommend going through this course with the files on your local computer.
cues.zh: 其實不建議用本機檔案上這課。

cues.en: Instead, I very strongly recommend using Google Colab.
It's free to use, you just need a Google account, and using Colab will help ensure that you can reproduce
cues.zh: 免費，只需要Google帳號；能幫助重現，

cues.en: all the code and all the results in this course, because that's the environment that I used to develop the course and teach the course.
cues.zh: 全部程式與結果，因為課程開發、教學都在那個環境。

cues.en: So when libraries are changed on Colab, then I can adapt the code accordingly.
cues.zh: Colab函式庫變動，我能跟著調整程式。

cues.en: So how do you get these files from your local computer into Colab?
The first step is to move these files from your local computer onto Google Drive.
cues.zh: 第一步，從本機搬到Google Drive。

cues.en: To do that, you go to drive.google.com.
You can create a new folder for this course.
That's what I've done here.
And then you simply grab the folder here from your local computer and you just drag it.
cues.zh: 從本機抓這個資料夾，直接拖。

cues.en: Literally just drag it on there and that will upload all of those files.
cues.zh: 真的拖上去，就會全部上傳。

cues.en: Takes a few minutes to upload, but it should be pretty fast.
Also, you know, if you have a Google Drive desktop synced to your local computer, then you know you can sync automatically.
cues.zh: 如果Google Drive桌面版已和電腦同步，也能自動同步。

cues.en: Anyway, once you have the files in your drive, you can open them up and you can go to any one of these files.
cues.zh: 檔案進Drive後，就可進去找任一個。

cues.en: And then you can open these Python notebook files, either by right clicking and selecting open with Google Colab.
cues.zh: Python筆記本可按右鍵，選用Google Colab開啟。

cues.en: Or you can simply double click and that will automatically open the file in a new tab in Google Colab.
cues.zh: 也可雙擊，自動在Colab新分頁開。

cues.en: And now you have the files here.
Now if you have absolutely no idea what you're looking at, then it means that you are brand new to
cues.zh: 如果完全不知道看的是什麼，表示全新接觸，

cues.en: Python or to Python notebooks, in which case you will need to learn some Python before being able to go through this course.
cues.zh: Python或筆記本，要先學一些Python，才能上這課。

cues.en: I have a Python tutorial at the very end of the course that you can skip to, or you can work through some other Python tutorials or other courses or books.
cues.zh: 課尾有Python教學，可先跳過去，也能學其他教學、課程或書。

cues.en: Now here's a question.
How do you know which files correspond to which lectures?
cues.zh: 怎麼知道哪檔對應哪段？

cues.en: Well, as I mentioned, I hope that the titles embedded in here are reasonably helpful.
cues.zh: 剛說，希望嵌在名稱的標題夠有用。

cues.en: I hope they are obvious enough in most cases just from looking at the name of the file.
But to be sure, I have also created a spreadsheet that maps all of the lecture names to the Python
cues.zh: 為確定，也做了試算表，把全部講座名稱對應Python，

cues.en: files, and that is linked from the GitHub repo here.
So if we scroll down a little bit and look for this list of lectures and topics here, then we can open up this spreadsheet over here.
cues.zh: 稍往下，找講座與主題清單，開這份試算表。

cues.en: I'll open it up in a new tab.
And here you see let me zoom on this a little bit.
Here you see a list of every single lecture in the course.
So we have these section names on the left.
And then the name of the video title and then the corresponding Python code file name.
cues.zh: 影片標題，再對應的Python程式檔名。

cues.en: Now if there is no code file for that particular video then there's just a little hyphen over here.
cues.zh: 如果那段沒有程式檔，就小橫線。

cues.en: Okay.
And then this column over here.
These numbers correspond to the video number in the Udemy player.
cues.zh: 數字對應Udemy播放器的影片編號。

cues.en: And then the last column over here is some key take home points from each individual lecture.
Sometimes these are pretty short.
Just 1 or 2 sentences.
Sometimes they're a little bit longer.
So this file is linked here from my GitHub repo.
You can also download it.
So you can look at this file on your browser online.
And you can also download it by clicking on file.
And then download as whatever format you like.
So that's it for this video.
You now know how to get all of the code that you need for this course.
cues.zh: 現在知道如何取得課程全部程式。
